items.title: Natural Gas Cash Prices Slip as Polo Remnants Head for Four Corners
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices slipped Tuesday as Hurricane Polo’s remnants closed in on the Four Corners region, bringing heavy rains that could dampen cooling demand.

items.title: AECO Gains as LNG Canada Expansion Adds 2 Bcf/d of Natural Gas Demand
items.summary: Western Canadian natural gas producers got a boost Tuesday from news that Shell had sanctioned the second phase of LNG Canada.

items.title: November Natural Gas Futures Stumble in Prompt Debut
items.summary: November natural gas futures slid in their first day as the prompt month Tuesday, pulled down by mild early October weather forecasts and restored Appalachian pipeline flows.

items.title: Petrobras Signs Long-Term Deal to Lift Cargoes from Cheniere Terminals
items.summary: Cheniere Energy said Tuesday it signed its first long-term agreement with Brazil’s state-owned Petrobras LNG to sell the company the super-chilled fuel for more than 20 years.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Slipping as Forecasts Shed Demand
items.summary: Typically light shoulder season demand weighed on November natural gas futures in the contract’s first session at the front of the curve, although lower production and tightening storage balances versus historical norms offered a bullish counterweigh

items.title: Technical Support Fails for Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: November natural gas futures debuted as the prompt month on Tuesday under pressure, owing in part to fading demand, downward momentum following a two-day slump and a technical floor that crumbled.

items.title: Shell Greenlights LNG Canada Expansion Amid Global Supply Crunch
items.summary: Shell on Tuesday sanctioned the second phase of LNG Canada, which would double the facility’s capacity to 28 Mt/y and boost output at a time when roughly 20% of global supplies have been curbed indefinitely by the Iran war.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Fight for Footing in November’s Debut at Front of Curve
items.summary: November natural gas futures searched for direction in morning action Tuesday as traders weighed bearish near-term weather against bullish production readings and a bright outlook for LNG volumes.

items.title: Oil's New Normal Is Higher Prices
